messages:
maria: Quick sync  we need a crisp run-of-show + rehearsal checklist for the Sept webinar. Topic: 'Graceful Degradation: routing, fallbacks, and lead routing'. Want to lock speakers + rehearsal slots today.
alex: +1 for that topic. Will present a short live demo of the fallback chain (5-7m).
priya: I'll cover runtime patterns and decision matrix (10m). Need a clean slide on model variants.
ben: Ops will present an anonymized incident timeline and checklist (5m). Can anyone redact logs by EOD?
sam: Creative can make 2 promo clips (15s & 30s). Need headshots and one-liner bios by Tue.
lee: Studio availability: 2026-09-08 or 2026-09-15. Which date works for final recording? calendar-bot: Tentative slots added -> https://cal.example.com/event/1829998888
emily: Sales asks: include a "Interested in Dedicated/Private" checkbox on the reg form and a field for monthly inference spend (optional). We'll route high-intent leads to Sales queue C.
maria: Proposed format: 40m main + 20m Q&A. Run-of-show draft:
```
00:00-00:05 - Welcome + poll + goals (maria)
00:05-00:15 - Runtime patterns & decision matrix (priya)
00:15-00:25 - Ops incident case study (ben)
00:25-00:32 - Live demo: fallback chain (alex)
00:32-00:40 - Panel checklist + next steps (all)
00:40-01:00 - Live Q&A + CTAs (all)
```
Keep demos short and have pre-recorded fallbacks.
alex: I'll pre-record the demo fallback and keep 2 minutes for live toggles.
priya: Abstracts needed: 60-90 words + 3 takeaways each. Deadline: Fri COB.
ben: I'll sanitize the incident timeline and upload screenshots by Thu. Need SRE redaction help.
sam: Slide schedule: rough deck by 9/1, final deck + assets by 9/7. Promo clips done by 9/3. Brand review on 9/6.
lee: Locking studio for 2026-09-15 10:00 PT unless someone pushes back. calendar-bot: Event updated -> Tue 2026-09-15 10:00 PT
emily: Sales form fields confirmed. Also asking for a post-webinar interest tag for 'Dedicated pilot'.
maria: Rehearsal plan: tech dry run (15m) on 9/10 09:00 PT, full run-through on 9/14 11:00 PT. Please RSVP in the doc.
alex: Noted. I'll bring the demo harness and a pre-recorded failover clip.
priya: I'll bring the decision matrix slide + examples.
sam: I'll build the slide template and social frames; drop any brand constraints in the doc.
ben: Incident timeline uploaded. Requesting redaction help from infra.
maria: Action items recap: Priya -> abstract + slides; Alex -> demo script + pre-record; Ben -> redacted incident; Sam -> assets + brand review; Lee -> final calendar + studio. Post everything to the shared webinar doc by Fri.
lee: Registration page created -> https://events.example.com/webinars/graceful-degradation. calendar-bot: Registration linked on event.
maria: Locking topic and run-of-show. If anyone has objections, flag in thread within 2 hours. Closing and moving notes into the webinar doc. Thanks!
